phases.meaning: Save registers, compare signed wrapped clock delta, and branch around reread.
phases.entry_contract: Caller supplies stack and general registers. Five original saves stay in place.

phases.meaning: Signed-state control flow
phases.entry_contract: Load and test signed state in DX. EAX holds 0/1 and is unchanged by the group.

phases.meaning: Extract the request, test the selected slot, and compute the lowering record index.
phases.entry_contract: EAX holds the input word sign-extended in reference and zero-extended in candidate. SAR followed by AND uses the same bits 13-15, and overwrites flags before they are consumed.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for lowering end
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Compute the primary record index and load its start tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Ordered field transfer
phases.entry_contract: AX is the primary start tile; reload the signed requested slot into EDX before storing AX to weapon_tile. Preserve both ordered volatile accesses.

phases.meaning: Compute the primary record index and load its end tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Compute the primary record index and load its projectile frame.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Ordered field transfer
phases.entry_contract: AX is the primary firing tile; reload the signed requested slot into EDX before storing AX to projectile_frame.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for primary projectile
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Convert the tile comparison to signed word direction 0 or -1 in AX.
phases.entry_contract: Signed comparison flags describe tile <= limit. SETLE, XOR AH, and DEC produce low AX, with upper bits and flags subsequently unused by the original path.

phases.meaning: Load the signed projectile type and call the original callback.
phases.entry_contract: The previous branch established that current tile equals projectile frame. EAX is overwritten with the signed type before the callback.

phases.meaning: Reject an unavailable secondary animation and reload the accepted request.
phases.entry_contract: The action equals 2. The group reads the request itself and does not consume incoming flags.

phases.meaning: Compute the secondary record index and load its start tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Ordered field transfer
phases.entry_contract: AX is the secondary start tile; reload the signed requested slot into EDX before storing AX to weapon_tile.

phases.meaning: Compute the secondary record index and load its end tile.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Compute the secondary record index and load its projectile frame.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended request. EAX becomes the record offset then its field in AX. No interleaved volatile accesses move.

phases.meaning: Ordered field transfer
phases.entry_contract: AX is the secondary firing tile; reload the signed requested slot into EDX before storing AX to projectile_frame.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for secondary projectile
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Secondary firing signed frame direction
phases.entry_contract: Incoming signed word CMP AX,DI flags describe tile <= limit. AX becomes 0 or -1 and is consumed by the store at 0x29f3f. Upper EAX is dead on either continuation; CMP DX,[weapon_tile] at 0x29f45 replaces the flags.

phases.meaning: Signed-state control flow
phases.entry_contract: DX is the nonzero state. Promote to full EDX and check lowering and direction. EAX remains live at both lowering successors, so neither tick reads nor their flags move.

phases.meaning: Transition a finished lowering animation to the start of raising.
phases.entry_contract: Both signed tile boundary paths arrive here without requiring a tick. The state store does not consume incoming flags.

phases.meaning: Signed-state control flow
phases.entry_contract: EDX carries the signed state after rejecting lowering. Test for start of raising.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for raising tiles
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: On a reverse raising tick, store the preceding tile and continue to offsets.
phases.entry_contract: ZF records the tick test (reference AX and candidate ECX both hold 0/1). BX contains the previous tile on both paths.

phases.meaning: Signed-state control flow
phases.entry_contract: After reaching the raising limit, load the requested slot into AX. The unchanged reference suffix updates selected slot and idle state.

phases.meaning: Signed-state control flow
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed state after rejecting raising. Test for firing and exit otherwise.

phases.meaning: Signed-state control flow
phases.entry_contract: ZF records whether the signed direction word is zero. Either enter the reverse path or read tile and limit in their original order. The comparison flags remain live.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for forward firing ready tile
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Compute the selected record index and load its ready tile after reverse firing.
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the sign-extended requested weapon. EAX becomes the signed ready tile in AX.

phases.meaning: Frame-offset preparation
phases.entry_contract: Capture displayed slot in SI, test the signed word, branch to default-frame calculation for zero. No prior register inputs or stack dependence.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for displayed base tile
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Frame-offset preparation
phases.entry_contract: Default displayed slot is zero. Read weapon_tile into BX and subtract1053; only the signed low word is consumed by the later frame calculation. Upper EBX/flags are overwritten before use.

phases.meaning: Frame-offset preparation
phases.entry_contract: BX is the signed frame word from either predecessor; reload the current displayed slot into full EDX for the retained row calculation. Other registers and flags are unchanged.

phases.meaning: Three-times-slot factor for displayed frame row
phases.entry_contract: EDX is the signed definition/displayed slot 0..7. EAX becomes 3*EDX, EDX and every other register are unchanged; SUB defines the same flags. No memory, calls or stack operations.

phases.meaning: Store screen offsets from DX and AX and return with all five registers restored.
phases.entry_contract: DX and AX hold X and Y. The same five saved registers are present in the same stack order.
